label: frontier • read a PDF and a workbook, produce a .docx brief and a .xlsx summary, verify by reading them back
query: Read report.pdf and budget.xlsx. Then (1) write summary.xlsx containing one sheet with each department and its Q3 figure, and (2) write brief.docx with a heading, a three-sentence summary of the report, and the total Q3 budget across all departments. Finally read both new files back with file_read to confirm they open, and tell me the total you computed.
notes: End-to-end unified file tools: document reads (PDF extraction + workbook preview), document writes routed by extension (.xlsx from rows, .docx from Markdown), and verification reads of generated documents. The Q3 total (311500) only exists as a derived number.

rubric: The final answer states the total Q3 budget as 311500 (or 311,500) and mentions that both generated files were verified by reading them back.
